mapper.select:
SELECT id, request_id, user_id, username, agent_code, agent_name, session_id, session_type, question, answer, start_time, end_time, duration_ms, model_ms, tool_ms, mcp_ms, skill_ms, segment_count, input_tokens, output_tokens, total_tokens, cached_tokens, model_reported_ms, trace_id, runtime_revision, runtime_content_hash, version_binding_json, experiment_id, experiment_revision, experiment_arm, experiment_deployment_id, experiment_bucket, success, error_msg FROM cw_agent_call_log
ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT #{q.limit} OFFSET #{q.offset}

SELECT COUNT(*) AS total_count, AVG(duration_ms) AS avg_duration_ms, MAX(duration_ms) AS max_duration_ms, AVG(model_ms) AS avg_model_ms, AVG(tool_ms) AS avg_tool_ms, AVG(mcp_ms) AS avg_mcp_ms, AVG(skill_ms) AS avg_skill_ms, COALESCE(SUM(total_tokens), 0) AS total_tokens, AVG(total_tokens) AS avg_total_tokens, COALESCE(SUM(cached_tokens), 0) AS cached_tokens, COALESCE(SUM(input_tokens), 0) AS input_tokens FROM cw_agent_call_log

SELECT DATE_FORMAT(FROM_UNIXTIME(start_time / 1000), #{dateFormat}) AS bucket, COUNT(*) AS cnt, AVG(duration_ms) AS avg_duration_ms, AVG(model_ms) AS avg_model_ms, AVG(tool_ms) AS avg_tool_ms, AVG(mcp_ms) AS avg_mcp_ms, AVG(skill_ms) AS avg_skill_ms, COALESCE(SUM(total_tokens), 0) AS total_tokens FROM cw_agent_call_log
GROUP BY bucket ORDER BY bucket ASC

WITH ranked AS ( SELECT experiment_arm, success, duration_ms, ROW_NUMBER() OVER ( PARTITION BY experiment_arm ORDER BY duration_ms ) AS latency_rank, COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY experiment_arm) AS arm_samples FROM cw_agent_call_log WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND experiment_id = #{experimentId} AND experiment_revision = #{revision} AND experiment_arm IN ('CONTROL', 'TREATMENT') AND start_time >= #{startedAtMs} AND start_time <= #{endedAtMs} ) SELECT experiment_arm AS arm, COUNT(*) AS samples, SUM(CASE WHEN success = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS errors, MAX(CASE WHEN latency_rank = CEIL(arm_samples * 0.95) THEN duration_ms ELSE NULL END) AS p95_latency_ms FROM ranked GROUP BY experiment_arm ORDER BY experiment_arm
